Cuba's Electrical Grid Collapses, Causing Nationwide Blackout

Cuba's electrical grid collapsed on Friday, resulting in a nationwide blackout. This marks the latest in a series of at least six partial or total grid failures this year. The island nation is experiencing ongoing difficulties with its power supply. The US Embassy issued a warning following the incident.
